thread: Andorhal is working: who inside the walls keeps the spread running?

evidence.clue: From the crest: a long low grey wall, roofs packed close, chimney smoke, a granary quarter of tall square timber buildings on stone feet with hoist beams, grain dust gold in the low sun; sacks going up on ropes; wagons in lines on the roads in (the longer line on the King's road to a bigger gate); bell, dog, mill wheel, man singing, bake ovens. 'It was working. Oh, it was working. Every road she'd marked on Sylvanas's sheet came in here.'
The drag beats under the whole city, 'slow and late, so much bigger than it had been all morning that she could feel it in the roots of her teeth.'
'And somebody in there kept it running, somebody who knew which wagon went to which yard and kept the books for it.'
The party is coming in by the back way (the south road) to the market gate rather than the King's road front gate.

Chapter 7: Andorhal is a working mill city under new scrutiny (grain spiked at the gate 'since the Exchange said'; every wagon sealed against a yard board; a chalker's second count). Sickness clusters on Mill Lane from spring, bad since high summer; the physicians call it 'the river damp'.

Chapter 7: the people who keep the spread running are in the granary district: eight disciplined sentries at Fenner's (including a runner who uses wall-crack dead drops), five masked contaminators at Kett's loft, three more going up Hurdle Lane at the bell. At least thirteen seen.
Chapter 7: grain leaves on other yards' copied marks (forty-one bills since midsummer); Kett's grain leaves on the first carts out; the cult separates outer watchers from inner contaminators.

readerKnows_chapter7: A cult cell of at least thirteen operates in the granary district, supplied by a factor nobody has met, contaminating grain at packaging and shipping it on copied marks; the party plans to take one alive that night.
povCharacterKnows_chapter7: Sylvanas and Jaina: the cell exists, with two layers, and Kett's loft is the packaging site. Who sits above is unknown.
readerKnows: The hub is alive and busy; the plague runs through it; whoever manages the spread is likely inside.
povCharacterKnows: Jaina: someone inside keeps it running. Sylvanas turned and waited; she heard 'The market gate.'
notes: Chapter 7 (Sylvanas POV) opens with the ride in and the one name they have, Captain Havel. Open question: who inside the walls directs the spread.
